title: Preserve decimal intent across numeric conversions
goal: Separate decimal source values from binary measurements when an upgrade changes conversion rounding, and choose an explicit rounding rule for displayed amounts.

selectionNotes: .NET 11 conversions round the exact source once; binary and decimal literals with similar text need not agree.
Compiler-folded conversions can change after an SDK rebuild even when the target framework is retained.

prerequisites: SDK console project targeting net11.0 with ImplicitUsings=enable and Nullable=enable. Import System.Globalization and System.Numerics; place the supplied partial class in namespace Playbook.Samples.
constraints: .NET 11 conversions round the exact source once; binary and decimal literals with similar text need not agree.

evidence.scope: Real target executions assert exact decimal values, both original BigInteger destination bit patterns, ties-to-even, and exceptions for NaN/infinity. This is not a full audit of every conversion direction, Math.Round migration or older-target/newer-SDK route. Actual managed execution; no mocks, cross-compilation or GA verification.
